headline: Transylvania leads HCAC scoring while Franklin finishes winless
dek: Transylvania closed the campaign with fourteen wins, three draws, and three losses, scoring 54 goals while conceding nineteen across all matches. Hanover also finished unbeaten in conference play, yet fell well short of Transylvania's attacking output. At the other end of the standings, Franklin went the entire season without a victory.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring splits sharply down the table: Transylvania's 54 goals outscore Manchester, Franklin, Mount St. Joseph, Anderson (Ind.), and Bluffton combined.

wire.line: Conference programs finished with nineteen wins, fourteen draws, and 28 losses against non-conference opponents.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four August matches remain past their scheduled dates without a published result: Berea against Midway, Transylvania against Muskingum, Lindsey Wilson against Berea, and Centre against Transylvania.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rose-Hulman forward Ryan Shapiro scored fifteen goals and added five assists from 46 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rose-Hulman goalkeeper Justin Burns recorded eleven shutouts while making 51 saves and conceding nineteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Franklin finished the season without a win, recording three draws and fourteen losses while scoring ten goals and conceding 41.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Transylvania midfielder McKay Wheatley supplied eleven assists alongside five goals on 42 shots.

last_match.line: The defeat ended an unbeaten run for Transylvania that had stretched back to September.
